A.note: Clean structure: overview table, supplies, safety notes and a reply slip in a compact single page. Key details such as date, venue and deadline are left as placeholders, and an empty box sits unexplained at the top.

B.note: The newsletter format and the schedule table are neat. Date, venue, cost and contact are all placeholders, there is no reply slip, and the visible draft label ('교사 초안·배포 전 확인') means it cannot go out as is.

C.note: Very complete: concrete overview, a per-class schedule table, supplies, detailed precautions, contacts and a consent reply slip are all filled in. Only the phone numbers and school name are placeholders, and it is nearly ready to send.

D.note: Concrete details throughout: dates, per-class departure and return times, a cost note and a reply deadline. The left column of the reply form wraps awkwardly, and the school name '우리 학교' is not a real name.
